overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on analyzing reference-free evaluation metrics for NLG (summarization and dialogue generation) rather than generating text itself. It uses existing human evaluation datasets and studies how well automatic metrics correlate with human judgments. The extraction was generally accurate with minor cleanup needed for duplicates and terminology.
